note: Four repeated pairs per worker count, two30-second measured rounds plus warmup, separate CPU-only source targets, full2GiB reference parity. Neoverse-N1 lacks SHA3; this measures the candidate portable NEON fallback, not the SHA3 path. The same generic verifier built on Graviton3 separately passed native Graviton2 rejection and full-size dirty-reuse checks. Actual per-worker variant order did not reverse; these measurements are order-limited, not balanced confirmation.
rate_definition: sum(completed hashes) / sum(actual elapsed including fence)
order_limitation: Early controller rotated variants using position in the reversed outer configuration loop. Per-configuration baseline/candidate order therefore did not always reverse. Retain measurements with this limitation; new confirmation uses stable configuration indices and verifies actual completed order. Native Windows four-pair confirmation and interhash direct reversal are unaffected.
